IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDING QUALITY HEALTH CARE SERVICES TO THE UNINSURED AND UNDERINSURED
IRS990.MissionDesc: FHCSD'S PRIMARY MISSION IS TO PROVIDE COMPREHENSIVE, ACCESSIBLE AND QUALITY HEALTH CARE SERVICES TO ALL INCOME LEVELS WITH A SPECIAL COMMITTMENT TO LOW INCOME MEDICALLY UNDERSERVED INDIVIDUALS.
IRS990.Desc: PRIMARY AND DENTAL CARE SERVICES AND AIDS PREVENTION -THROUGH US HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES WITH THE ASSISTANCE OF GRANT FUNDING. PRIMARY CARE AND DENTAL CARE ARE PROVIDED TO THE SOCIALLY DISADVANTAGED. ALSO, THROUGH US HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, AIDS EDUCATION AND INSTRUCTION ON PREVENTATIVE MEASURES ARE PROVIDED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FAMILY HEALTH CENTERS OF SAN DIEGO (FHCSD) PARTICIPATED AND CONTRIBUTED $1 MILLION DOLLARS TO THE "COALITION TO PROTECT ACCESS TO HEALTH CARE", THIS IS THE MAXIMUM CONTRIBUTION LOBBYING NONTAXABLE AMOUNT SPECIFIED IN THE IRS SECTION 4911.

THE HEALTH CENTER HAS BEEN RECOGNIZED AS A NOT-FOR-PROFIT ORGANIZATION UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)3 AND CALIFORNIA REVENUE CODE SECTION 23701(D) AND IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES ON RELATED INCOME. FOR THE YEARS ENDED JUNE 30, 2024 ND 2023 THE HEALTH CENTER GENERATED REVENUE FROM AN UNRELATED BUSINESS ACTIVITY AND WAS TAXED ACCORDINGLY. EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2009, THE HEALTH CENTER ADOPTED NEWLY ISSUED GUIDANCE ON ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES. UNDER THIS NEW GUIDANCE, THE HEALTH CENTER UTILIZED A TWO-STEP APPROACH TO RECOGNIZING AND MEASURING UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS (TAX CONTINGENCIES). THE FIRST STEP IS TO EVALUATE THE TAX POSITION FOR RECOGNITION BY DETERMINING IF THE WEIGHT OF AVAILABLE EVIDENCE INDICATES IT IS MORE LIKELY THAN NOT THAT THE POSITION WILL BE SUSTAINED ON AUDIT, INCLUDING RESOLUTION OF RELATED APPEALS OR LITIGATION PROCESSES. THE SECOND STEP IS TO MEASURE THE TAX BENEFIT AS THE LARGEST AMOUNT, WHICH IS MORE THAN 50% LIKELY OF BEING REALIZED UPON ULTIMATE SETTLEMENT. AS A RESULT OF THE ADOPTION OF ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES, THE HEALTH CENTER DID NOT RECOGNIZE AN INCREASE OR DECREASE IN THE LIABILITY FOR UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS RELATED TO TAX POSITIONS TAKEN IN PRIOR PERIODS; THEREFORE, THERE WAS NOT CORRESPONDING ADJUSTMENT TO UNRESTRICTED NET ASSETS. ADDITIONALLY, FOR THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2024 THERE WERE NO ADDITIONAL LIABILITIES RECORDED FOR UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS RELATED TO TAX POSITIONS TAKEN IN THE CURRENT YEAR. THE HEALTH CENTER CONSIDERS MANY FACTORS WHEN EVALUATING AND ESTIMATING IT'S TAX POSITIONS AND TAX BENEFITS, WHICH MAY REQUIRE PERIODIC ADJUSTMENTS AND WHICH MAY NOT ACCURATELY FORECAST ACTUAL OUTCOMES. THERE WERE NO OUTSTANDING ACCRUALS FOR INTEREST AND PENALTIES RELATED TO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS SINCE THE INCEPTION DATE THROUGH THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2024. THE HEALTH CENTER HAS DETERMINED THAT IT'S MAJOR TAX JURISDICTIONS ARE THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AND ALL OTHER STATES WITHIN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. THE YEAR 2024 REMAINS OPEN AND SUBJECTS TO EXAMINATION BY THE APPROPRIATE GOVERNMENTAL AGENCIES IN THE UNITED STATES THROUGH 2029.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS SUBMITTED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND MANAGEMENT FOR REVIEW. UPON FINAL APPROVAL, THE FORM IS FINALIZED AND SUBMITTED TO THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FHCSD MONITORS AND ENFORCES COMPLIANCE WITH THE FHCSD'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY BY HAVING A CORPORATE COMPLIANCE COMMITTEE ACTIVELY AND PERIODICALLY PERFORMING AUDITS TO ENSURE COMPLIANCE. STAFF ARE TRAINED ANNUALLY TO REMIND THEM OF THEIR ONGOING OBLIGATION TO REPORT ANY INCIDENT OF FRAUD OR CONFLICT OF INTEREST. THERE IS A HOTLINE TO CALL WHERE THEY CAN REMAIN ANONYMOUS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PROCESS OF DETERMING COMPENSATION FOR THE FHCSD'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND KEY EMPLOYEES INVOLVES OUR HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT. IT IS BASED ON A NUMBER OF CONSIDERATIONS SUCH AS THE NATURE AND SCOPE OF INDIVIDUAL DUTIES, BACKGROUND, EXPERTISE, SIZE, COMPLEXITY OF ORGANIZATION, AND AMOUNT PAID BY SIMILAR ORGANIZATIONS OF SIMILAR SIZE AND TYPE. HUMAN RESOURCES ROUTINELY CONDUCTS SALARY SURVEYS AND PERFORMS ASSESSMENTS OF THE JOB MARKET. THE FINAL DECISION RESTS WITH THE GOVERNING BOARD WHEN THE ANNUAL CORPORATE BUDGET IS REVIEWED AND APPROVED FOR ADOPTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FAMILY HEALTH CENTERS OF SAN DIEGO'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, POLICIES AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE MADE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
ALL REVIEW AND PROCESS FOR THE OVERSIGHT OF THE AUDIT OF ITS FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SELECTION OF AN INDEPENDENT AUDITOR REMAINS CONSISTENT BETWEEN YEARS.
